caption: The drawing consists of a geometric, symmetrical pattern centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The main pattern is contained within a square with slightly rounded and notched corners, bordered by a green frame at the top and bottom edges. Inside the green border is a narrower, dark blue square border. The interior of the design features a radial, starburst-like motif made of jagged blue shapes that extend outward symmetrically from the center, interspersed with sections of beige or light tan color that form an alternating pattern. The symmetry is fourfold, dividing the shape neatly into quadrants. The page itself has various small brown stains or marks scattered across the surface, and there are two small inscriptions, one in the bottom left corner reading "L 1726. G" and another in the bottom right corner, "Ruth M. Barrow."
title: Coverlet
